answer.answer: PM SVANidhi stands for "PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi" [E01]. Its intended beneficiary group is street vendors, including hawkers, thelewala, rehriwala, and others engaged in small-scale vending activities [E01]. The scheme also extends to vendors from surrounding development, peri-urban, and rural areas vending within the geographical limits of Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) [E02].
